principals.name: A
principals.description: the initiator: generates nonces, encrypts and decrypts messages with the long-term key shared with KDC, and uses the session key to authenticate to B.

principals.name: B
principals.description: the responder/service: generates nonces, decrypts and encrypts KDC-protected messages with its long-term key, and uses the session key to authenticate A.

principals.name: KDC
principals.description: the trusted key distribution center: decrypts B's instruction with B's long-term key, generates the session key, encrypts A's response with A's long-term key, and issues the ticket encrypted for B.

values.name: KDC
values.description: The key distribution center KDC's identity.

values.name: K_ka
values.description: K_ka is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.

values.name: K_kb
values.description: K_kb is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.
